units.source_text: 父亲的病不如想象的那样严重。

en.t: Father's illness was not as serious as I had imagined.

units.source_text: 不过，我到家的时候，他还是盘腿坐在被褥上，说：“大家都不放心，

en.t: Still, when I arrived home, he was sitting cross-legged on the bedding and said, "Everyone is worried,

units.source_text: 我也只好这么待着不动。

en.t: so I have no choice but to sit here like this and keep still.

units.source_text: 真是的，完全可以下地了嘛。”

en.t: Honestly, I am perfectly able to get up already."

units.source_text: 第二天开始，父亲就不听母亲的劝阻，非要让她把被褥给收拾了。

en.t: From the next day on, Father ignored Mother's attempts to stop him and insisted that she put the bedding away.

units.source_text: 母亲拗不过父亲，只得一边叠着土布被子，一边对我说：“你爹一看你回来，

en.t: Mother could not prevail against Father, and as she folded the coarse cotton quilt, she said to me, "The moment your father saw you come home,

units.source_text: 我也没有感觉父亲的动作有多么吃力。

en.t: Nor did I feel that Father's movements seemed especially labored.

units.source_text: 哥哥在很远的九州做事，不到万不得已的时候，是不能轻易回来看父母亲的。

en.t: My elder brother worked far away in Kyushu, and unless matters became absolutely unavoidable, he could not easily come back to see our parents.

units.source_text: 妹妹嫁到了外乡，除非特别要紧的事，也不是一叫就能回来的。

en.t: My younger sister had married into another place, and unless something especially urgent happened, she too could not return the moment she was called.

units.source_text: 兄妹三人中，最痛快的还是我这个学生，

en.t: Among the three siblings, the one with the most freedom was still me, the student,

units.source_text: 我能按照母亲的嘱咐，撂下学校的课业，

en.t: for I could do as Mother asked and set aside my schoolwork,

units.source_text: 在放假之前赶回来，令父亲非常满足。

en.t: and my hurrying home before the holidays made Father very satisfied.

units.source_text: “这点儿病就让你请假回来，真不应该，都怪你妈写信太夸大了。”

en.t: "It was wrong to make you take leave and come home for such a slight illness. It is all your mother's fault for exaggerating so much in her letter."

units.source_text: 父亲不光嘴上这样说，还叫母亲把一直铺着的被褥收拾起来，

en.t: Father did not merely say this; he also had Mother put away the bedding that had been spread out all along,

units.source_text: 表示他像平时一样健康。

en.t: showing that he was as healthy as usual.

units.source_text: “你也不能太大意，不然又得复发，那就不好了。”

en.t: "You must not be too careless either. If it comes back again, that would be bad."

units.source_text: 对于我的提醒，父亲显得很高兴，又有些不大在乎。

en.t: Father seemed pleased by my warning, though he also treated it rather lightly.

units.source_text: “没关系，只要像以前那样，多留点儿神就是了。”

en.t: "It is all right. As long as I take a little care, just as I used to, that will be enough."
